title: Avoiding the AIceberg - How blindly trusting tech hurts us all
partialText: Notes of my talk at the German Science Society about the current state of AI and our approach to it. It is a lot like the blind belief in technology that cost a lot of people their lives when the Titanic sank.

title: Pardon my dust 2 – redesigning christianheilmann.com
partialText: Shifting my blog away from Godaddy and Wordpress has become a full-on redesign of the site. You can check it out now and I explain some of the CSS magic I added.

title: Without-love – a creative coding challenge
partialText: Calling out an creative coding challenge to win tickets for WeAreDevelopers events. Can you turn Lao Tzu quotes into something cool? And yes, we gave the tasks to AI agents, too.

title: Pardon my dust – re-homing 21 years of blog content of christianheilmann.com
partialText: "Currently I am having a lot of SSL problems and performance issues with this blog and the problem is my hosting. So I am re-writing 21 years worth of blogging to another stack and will re-home the content. Watch me."

title: Returning to Bengaluru in November, see you there.
partialText: "After the San Jose World Congress, WeAreDevelopers heads to Bengaluru, India, for two days of developer talks and workshops starting 25 November 2026."
